description: Change of use from B1 (offices) and D1 (day care centre) to D1 place of worship including the erection of a side extension and minor amendments to the ground floor.
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of six months from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted  therewith and numbered Design and Access Statement, Transport Statement;  5039/01, 02, 03, 10, 11, 12, 13, 18c, 20, 21, 22, 23, 30B, 31B, 32B, 35, 60, 61, 62, 63, 65B, 66B, 67B and 68B       
Received: 13 April 2010 and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - Twenty-eight parking spaces shall be kept permanently available at the site for use by visitors and staff of the community centre.
Condition : 4 - The windows and doors to the building shall remain closed outside of the hours 7.00am to 21.00pm any day of the week when the building is in use.
Condition : 5 - No system for the amplification of sound or speech shall be used internal to the building outside of the hours 7.00am to 21.00pm any day of the week.
Condition : 6 - No system for the amplification of sound or speech shall be used external to the building.

Condition : 7 - No activity shall be carried out on the outside spaces of the building (balcony and terraces) on the site outside of the hours 7.00am to 21.00pm any day of the week. Should the applicant wish to carry out activity outside the building on certain festival days or for other activities, the application for council permission shall include any means to mitigate against potential harm to residents through the activities of worshippers, including traffic management and parking control measures.

Condition : 8 - Full details of both hard and soft landscape works shall be submitted for approval in writing by the Local Planning Authority within 6 months of the granting of the application and these works shall be carried out as approved and thereafter maintained. These details shall include means of enclosure; hard surfacing materials; proposed functional services above and below ground (e.g. drainage, power, communications cables, pipelines etc.); schedules of plants, noting species, plant sizes and proposed numbers/densities where appropriate.  

The hard and soft landscape works shall be carried out prior to the occupation of any part of the development in accordance with a programme to be agreed in writing with the Local Planning Authority.

All planting comprised in the approved details of landscaping shall be carried out in the first planting season following the occupation or completion of the development, whichever is the sooner; and any trees or plants which, within a period of 5 years from the completion of the development die, are removed or become seriously damaged or diseased, shall be replaced in the next planting season with others of similar size or species, unless the Local Planning Authority gives written consent to any variation.

Condition : 9 - "Before the development hereby permitted commences the applicant must either:
a.	Investigate the site for landfill gas to the satisfaction of the LPA, to ascertain whether gas protection measures are required.  Where measures are required the details shall be submitted to, and approved by, the LPA.
Or;
b.	The applicant shall install gas protection measures as a precautionary measure without first investigating the site.  The details of these measures shall be submitted to, and approved by, the LPA.
c.	For a. and b. all required measures shall be installed before the development is first occupied.

Condition : 10 - No development shall take place until details of a Sustainable Drainage Scheme, including measures for the harvesting of rainwater, the minimisation of water run-off from the building, by at least 50% of that of the undeveloped site, and the conservation and reuse as appropriate of other water supplies in the building have been submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority.  These details shall be carried out as approved.
